description: This file defines a Sidebar component and related UI elements for a React application, including context management, toggle functionality, and various subcomponents for sidebar content, menu, and controls.

methods.name: useSidebar
methods.description: Custom hook to access sidebar context, throws error if used outside provider.

methods.name: SidebarProvider
methods.description: Provides sidebar state and controls via React context, manages open/close state, cookies, and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: Sidebar
methods.description: Main sidebar component with responsive behavior for mobile and desktop, supports variants and collapsible options.

methods.name: SidebarTrigger
methods.description: Button to toggle sidebar open/close state.

methods.name: SidebarRail
methods.description: Button for toggling sidebar in a rail style, with resize cursor.

methods.name: SidebarInset
methods.description: Main content area when sidebar is inset.

methods.name: SidebarInput
methods.description: Input component styled for sidebar use.

methods.name: sidebarMenuButtonVariants
methods.description: CVA variants for sidebar menu buttons.

methods.name: SidebarMenuButton
methods.description: Button for sidebar menu with optional tooltip.

methods.name: SidebarMenuAction
methods.description: Action button in sidebar menu, with hover and show on hover options.

methods.name: SidebarMenuBadge
methods.description: Badge element for sidebar menu items.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSkeleton
methods.description: Skeleton placeholder for sidebar menu items.
